The problem
On Solana, every send needs SOL. That’s where alt wallets get caught.
01
An empty tank
Your alt wallet holds tokens but no SOL, so it can’t pay the network fee.
02
The obvious fix
You send it a little SOL from your main wallet so it can move.
03
The leak
That top-up is public. Every explorer now shows the alt was funded by your main wallet.

How it works
Four parties. One rule: no SOL from main to alt.
Who
What they do
Main wallet
Pays USDC into Ghost once and gets a gas note (ghost-gas:v1:…)
Alt wallet
Holds the tokens, attaches the note and signs the transfer, with 0 SOL
Ghost relayer
Pays the Solana fee as fee payer and takes a flat 0.01 USDC from the note
Recipient
Gets the tokens straight from the alt. They never pass through Ghost

Under the hood
The relayer only pays for what it should.
01
Note has credit
Balance checked and the fee reserved before anything is broadcast.
02
Token transfers only
Strict allowlist: TransferChecked, compute budget, one account create.
03
Signs as fee payer
Ghost pays the SOL fee and nothing else. Fee caps and hourly rate limits.
04
Strict deposits
Allowlisted mints, freshness checks, memo-bound claims. Fails closed.
05
Tokens never touch Ghost
They go straight from the alt to the recipient.
06
0.01 USDC per send
A flat debit from the note, finalised after the send lands.

Who it’s for
Anyone who keeps wallets apart.
Multi-wallet operators
Trading, ops and personal wallets that should stay separate.
Token-only wallets
Wallets that got an airdrop or payroll tokens but hold no SOL.
Privacy-minded users
People who refuse the main-to-alt SOL link on principle.
Product builders
Sign-and-send UX without making users buy SOL first.
Teams and treasuries
Prepay fee credit for operators instead of funding every key.
One rule
If a wallet holds tokens but no SOL, Ghost lets it move.

Business model
$0.01
flat USDC fee on every sponsored send. The margin is that fee minus the SOL Ghost pays.
Per-send fee
0.01 USDC debited from the gas note on each send
Deposit haircut
A small cut on non-USDC top-ups, priced with Jupiter
Next
Volume tiers, partner revenue share, prepaid credit packs for teams
Costs: RPC, SOL for sponsorship, hosting, support
